message: When storms roll in, I like to think of it as nature's way of inviting us to cozy up indoors. It's the perfect excuse to gather snacks, find a good book, and make sure we have what we need handy. I came across a great resource that offers helpful tips on how to prepare for those blustery days. It’s nice to be ready for whatever Mother Nature decides to throw our way, don’t you think? 🌧️
